lead: A framed `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/queue.rs` case runs under one filtered `cargo test`, but `NVS_DB_MATRIX_CA` must be an absolute path.
body: The six variables are the ones `tools/db-matrix.py` sets, their values are in `tests/db/compose.yaml`, and the anchor comes out with `docker compose -f tests/db/compose.yaml cp mysql:/certs/ca.crt <abs path>`. A *relative* path resolves against the crate directory, so the first case panics inside `open` with a bare `NotFound` and every later one reports `Once instance has previously been poisoned`, which reads as a broken fixture.
